description: Phone validation and normalization to E.164 (FR-CRT-09). Syrian mobile numbers are accepted as 09XXXXXXXX and +9639XXXXXXXX; customers abroad may enter any valid international number in + form. The API uses libphonenumber-js and the app must agree on every case below.
rules: Before parsing: map Arabic-Indic digits to 0..9, remove spaces, dashes, dots and parentheses, and turn a leading 00 into +.
A number without + is parsed with Syria (SY) as the default region.
Syrian numbers must be mobile numbers: +9639 followed by 8 digits.
Output is E.164, or null when invalid.
